interpretation: The official native-CRS WFS index identifies exactly this ASC tile and the same grid bounds as its ASC header. Its CRS is ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N (EPSG:25832). This supports using EPSG:25832 as the project horizontal working CRS for the tile. Preserve the dataset lineage statement about ETRF2000 at epoch 2008.0 separately; the index does not resolve the metadata distinction between the ETRS89 ensemble and the specific ETRF2000 realization.
dataset_metadata_crs: EPSG:4258 (geographic ETRS89, not a projected raster CRS)
dataset_lineage_statement: Sistema di riferimento: realizzazione ETRF2000 - all'epoca 2008.0 - del Sistema di riferimento geodetico europeo ETRS89. Le quote ortometriche sono riferite al modello geoidico ITALGEO 2005.
vertical_note: Do not interpret the ASC Z values as ellipsoidal height or apply a geoid correction; use source orthometric metres with a documented local offset.
precision_note: The map/index CRS is verified; no claim is made that the source ASC carries a formal CRS definition or that the exact ETRF2000 realization is EPSG:25832.
